body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sony Ericsson today introduces the beautifully simple phone 'C510 Cyber-shot' at 2009 CES. It is equipped with a 3.2M Cyber-show camera with Smile Shutter and face detection technology of up to three faces at a time.
The C510 Cyber-shot' is expected to be available in selected markets from Q1 2009.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
